conditional_resistance_screen.qualification: Sensitivity screen only: excludes vias, spreading, AC inductance, effective capacitor ESR/ESL and actual load/current partition. Not a measured current or PI approval.

method_limits: 25um pixel-grid morphology and regional comparisons are screens, not exact physical neck width or conductive current distribution. In1 projection does not prove the actual adjacent reference plane for B.Cu (In2 AON), return-loop transfer impedance or EMI.
